name: color spray
lore:
# Color Spray: The Prismatic Torrent

To the uninitiated, *Color Spray* is a mere trick of the light; to the veteran, it is a sensory executioner. When the Weave is gathered for this evocation, the caster feels a frantic, high-frequency vibration against their palms, as if clutching a handful of humming, jagged glass. Upon release, the air doesn't merely glow—it shatters. A discordant fan of clashing, impossible hues erupts from the fingertips, a kaleidoscopic cacophony that overloads the optic nerves of any caught in its path.

The spell’s lineage traces back to the eccentric Archmage Vaelen the Iridescent. Legend claims Vaelen spent decades attempting to bottle the dawn’s first light within a diamond prism. During a moment of frustration, he struck the gem with a resonant counter-spell. Instead of shattering the stone, the magic refracted through its facets with such violent intensity that it temporarily blinded his entire retinue. Vaelen, ever the scholar, ignored their cries and immediately recorded the somatic gestures of this "beautiful, blinding discord."

Take heed: while it lacks the lethal bite of fire, the disorientation of *Color Spray* buys the most precious currency in a dungeon—time.
